integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.bemfaDesc: Enable voice control of devices via Bemfa cloud (Xiao Ai, Tmall Genie).
integrations.bemfaUidHint: Bemfa console → Console → Private key (32-hex or 45-char)

integrations.stateAgentOfflineHint: The wake agent is offline. The integration will sync automatically once it comes back.
integrations.stateDisconnectedHint: Bemfa MQTT connection failed. Check that the UID is correct.
integrations.stateDisabledHint: Integration is paused. Bemfa device topics are retained but voice wake is disabled.
integrations.v2Hint: Fill secretID/secretKey to use the recommended v2 API. Leave empty for v1 (UID only).
integrations.mijiaGuide: How to enable voice control with Xiao Ai
integrations.mijiaStep1: Ensure the Bemfa integration above is connected
integrations.mijiaStep2: Open Mi Home app → Profile → Third-party devices → Add → select "Bemfa"
integrations.mijiaStep3: Enter your Bemfa account (the one matching the UID above)
integrations.mijiaStep4: Say "Xiao Ai, turn on {device}" to wake your computer
integrations.mijiaWarning: Without Mi Home binding, Bemfa topics are still created, but voice control won't work.
